name: gs1-epcis
label: GS1 / EPCIS 2.0
description: Supply chain event tracking — EU pharma mandate, retail standard

table_notes.gs1_location: Physical or logical party locations identified by GS1 GLN (Global Location Number); root table for all spatial references in EPCIS events.
table_notes.gs1_trade_item: Master record for every tradeable product identified by a GTIN; drives lot tracking and regulatory-controlled-item flags.
table_notes.epcis_event: Core EPCIS 2.0 event record capturing the five W's (what/where/when/why/how) for a single supply chain business step.
table_notes.epcis_epc: Individual serialized item identifiers (EPCs) participating in an EPCIS event; one row per EPC per event.
table_notes.epcis_quantity: Aggregate quantity elements within an EPCIS event for items tracked by GTIN+quantity rather than individual serial numbers.

gs1_location.name: gln
gs1_location.description: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN-13) uniquely identifying this party or location

gs1_location.name: name
gs1_location.description: Human-readable name of the location or party (e.g. warehouse, store, ship-from address)

gs1_location.name: address
gs1_location.description: Structured postal address: {street, city, state, postalCode, countryCode (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)}

gs1_location.name: geo_location
gs1_location.description: PostGIS WGS84 point for spatial proximity and mapping queries

gs1_location.name: parent_gln
gs1_location.description: GLN of the parent location (e.g. facility GLN for a sub-location dock door)

gs1_location.name: is_active
gs1_location.description: Whether this location is currently operational and valid for use in new events

gs1_trade_item.name: gtin
gs1_trade_item.description: GS1 Global Trade Item Number (GTIN-14) uniquely identifying this product SKU

gs1_trade_item.name: description
gs1_trade_item.description: Product description as registered with GS1 or the brand owner

gs1_trade_item.name: brand_name
gs1_trade_item.description: Commercial brand name under which this item is sold

gs1_trade_item.name: gpc_category
gs1_trade_item.description: GS1 Global Product Classification (GPC) brick code categorising the product type

gs1_trade_item.name: net_content
gs1_trade_item.description: Net content quantity of the trade item (unit determined by uom)

gs1_trade_item.name: uom
gs1_trade_item.description: Unit of measure for net_content; coded per GS1 UN/ECE Recommendation 20 (e.g. KGM, LTR, EA)

gs1_trade_item.name: lot_tracking
gs1_trade_item.description: True if this item requires lot-level traceability (typical for pharma and food)

gs1_trade_item.name: regulated
gs1_trade_item.description: True if this item is subject to regulatory serialization mandates (e.g. EU FMD, DSCSA)

epcis_event.name: id
epcis_event.description: EPCIS 2.0 event ID; UUID generated by the capturing application (globally unique)

epcis_event.name: event_type
epcis_event.description: EPCIS event class: ObjectEvent, AggregationEvent, TransactionEvent, TransformationEvent

epcis_event.name: event_time
epcis_event.description: Business time when the event occurred as declared by the trading partner

epcis_event.name: event_timezone
epcis_event.description: UTC offset at event_time (e.g. +02:00); preserved separately per EPCIS 2.0 spec

epcis_event.name: record_time
epcis_event.description: Wall-clock time when this event was captured and stored in the repository

epcis_event.name: biz_step
epcis_event.description: GS1 CBV business step URI indicating the business process (e.g. cbv:BizStep-shipping, -receiving)

epcis_event.name: disposition
epcis_event.description: GS1 CBV disposition URI describing object condition after the event (e.g. cbv:Disp-in_transit)

epcis_event.name: read_point_gln
epcis_event.description: GLN of the physical read point where the event was observed; references gs1_location.gln

epcis_event.name: biz_location_gln
epcis_event.description: GLN of the business location for this event (e.g. storage room); references gs1_location.gln

epcis_event.name: biz_transaction
epcis_event.description: Array of business transaction references: [{type: cbv:BTT-po, bizTransaction: urn:...}]

epcis_event.name: extensions
epcis_event.description: Vendor or community extension fields in EPCIS 2.0 JSON-LD context format

epcis_epc.name: event_id
epcis_epc.description: EPCIS event this EPC participates in; references epcis_event.id

epcis_epc.name: epc
epcis_epc.description: EPC URI identifying a specific serialized item (e.g. urn:epc:id:sgtin:0614141.107346.2017)

epcis_epc.name: action
epcis_epc.description: EPCIS action for this EPC within the event: ADD, OBSERVE, or DELETE

epcis_epc.name: lot_number
epcis_epc.description: Manufacturer lot or batch number for lot-tracked items (pharma AI 10, food traceability)

epcis_epc.name: serial_number
epcis_epc.description: Item-level serial number (GS1 AI 21); disambiguates units within the same GTIN+lot

epcis_epc.name: expiry_date
epcis_epc.description: Product expiry or best-before date (GS1 AI 17); mandatory for pharma under EU FMD/DSCSA

epcis_quantity.name: event_id
epcis_quantity.description: EPCIS event this quantity element belongs to; references epcis_event.id

epcis_quantity.name: gtin
epcis_quantity.description: GTIN-14 of the product being counted; references gs1_trade_item.gtin

epcis_quantity.name: quantity
epcis_quantity.description: Number of units (or measured amount) of the product involved in this event

epcis_quantity.name: uom
epcis_quantity.description: Unit of measure for quantity; coded per GS1 UN/ECE Recommendation 20 (e.g. EA, KGM, LTR)

short_description: Supply chain event tracking — EU pharma mandate, retail standard
long_description: GS1/EPCIS 2.0 (Electronic Product Code Information Services) enables real-time tracking of physical products through supply chains using standardized events. The schema captures the five W's for each supply chain event: What (EPC/GTIN), Where (GLN location), When (timestamp), Why (business step/disposition), and How (EPCIS extensions). Supports full traceability from manufacturer to patient/consumer.
when_to_use: Use for pharmaceutical track-and-trace (EU FMD mandate), food safety traceability (FDA FSMA 204), and retail supply chain visibility. Required by EU Falsified Medicines Directive, US Drug Supply Chain Security Act, and China CFDA for pharmaceuticals. Walmart, Amazon, and major grocers mandate EPCIS for suppliers.
